product_family: Scheduling and meeting booking software with customizable workflows, video conferencing, and automation. Notable sub-products: Cal.com (managed cloud service), Cal.diy (open-source community edition), Cal.ai (AI phone agent for automated scheduling).

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Cal.com's SOC 2 Type II certification is audited by an independent third party, proving our controls work as intended. Cal.com undergoes an independent external audit every year to maintain our SOC 2 Type II certification.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Cal.com's privacy-by-design scheduling software meets ISO 27001 standards. HIPAA, ISO 27001, SOC 2 Compliant Scheduling App.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Cal.com offers a HIPAA compliant Enterprise plan that includes a signed Business Associate Agreement (BAA) and features designed to protect PHI, such as encrypted data storage, access logging, and customizable intake workflows.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Cal.com's privacy-by-design scheduling software meets GDPR standards. Cal.com offers a Europe option (Cal.eu) that ensures scheduling data stays within Europe, adhering to GDPR regulations.

certifications.name: CCPA
certifications.proof_quote: Cal.com's data protection rights are covered by the CCPA. Cal.com engages a limited number of third-party service providers to support the delivery of our services, all bound by confidentiality and data protection obligations consistent with applicable privacy laws.

privacy.ai_training_note: No public evidence found that Cal.com trains its core scheduling engine on customer data. Cal.ai (AI phone agent) is a separate opt-in product; no specific claims found about training practices for that service.
privacy.data_region: Dual availability: US-based default, EU-based option (Cal.eu) available for GDPR compliance with data stored and processed within EU borders.

security.name: Encryption
security.value: Data encrypted in transit and at rest with continuous monitoring and vulnerability management

security.name: Penetration Testing
security.value: Annual third-party penetration testing of web application; regular internal penetration tests

security.name: Access Logging
security.value: Encrypted access logs with role-based access control (RBAC) and audit trails for enterprise plans

security.name: Availability
security.value: 99.9% uptime SLA for Enterprise, with option for 99.99% SLA available

security.name: Continuous Monitoring
security.value: Automated continuous monitoring and Vanta-based compliance monitoring year-round with external auditor verification annually

products.name: Cal.com Cloud (Free Plan)
products.data_scope: Unlimited event types, calendar syncing, workflow automation, basic video conferencing (Cal Video), Stripe payment integration
products.notes: Most feature-rich free tier among competing scheduling tools; no credit card required; unlimited for individuals

products.name: Cal.com Teams ($16/user/month)
products.data_scope: Round-robin scheduling, shared team availability, team workflows, advanced reporting
products.notes: Designed for small business teams and distributed sales/support groups

products.name: Cal.com Organizations ($37/user/month)
products.data_scope: Org-wide admin controls, centralized management, sub-team structure, advanced access control
products.notes: For mid-size to large companies requiring enterprise governance without full enterprise pricing

products.name: Cal.com Enterprise (Custom Pricing)
products.data_scope: HIPAA BAA, priority support, dedicated database, 99.9% SLA (99.99% option), white-labeling, SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, domain enforcement, custom data residency
products.notes: Compliant for regulated industries (healthcare, finance). Includes custom domain support via own SMTP (upcoming feature). Most HIPAA-friendly option.

products.name: Cal.ai (AI Phone Agent)
products.data_scope: Automated phone calls for meeting scheduling, AI-powered booking agent
products.notes: Separate product; add-on to main platform; reduces booking friction through voice automation

products.name: Cal.diy (Open Source Community Edition)
products.data_scope: Full scheduling engine, app store framework, booking infrastructure; MIT-licensed
products.notes: 100% MIT-licensed; no proprietary features; designed for personal/hobbyist self-hosting; not recommended for production; community-maintained

compare.pricing_model: Freemium: Free tier (unlimited for individuals) + Team ($16/user/month) + Organization ($37/user/month) + Enterprise (custom). Cal.diy is free and open source (MIT).
compare.data_residency: Dual: US-based by default; EU-based option (Cal.eu) available for GDPR and data sovereignty requirements
